news.headline: Datadog (DDOG) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim After Mixed Views On Q4 And AI Demand
news.summary: Datadog’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$292.36 to US$271.71 per share, which marks a modest reset in how the stock is being valued today. Analysts are split, with some pointing to strong Q3 results, AI related demand and Datadog’s broad customer base, while others lean on softer Q4 guidance, early renewals and volume discounts when considering where the stock should trade.
